title: After the Japanese Derby: The Ines Chant

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wheeze… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: What a race! Ines Fujin secures a fantastic victory at the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Just listen as the crowd goes wild! A thunderous round of applause for this year's Derby champion!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! I did it! I really did it!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm… the Derby champion! Aha… hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text: Insane! That was totally wild, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: That was crazy! She looks totally wiped out! But still…

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Why does she look so freakin' cool?!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: Big Sis! That was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe… I don't know what to do with myself! These cheers… are all for me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Is it really okay to have such an incredible moment all to myself?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, I have to go. Everyone is applauding me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I have to hurry to the winner's circle.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Ah.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Agh… Ahaha. It's no good. I can barely stay standing…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But I have to move… I have to respond to everyone's cheers…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aha… I, uh, don't think I can move right now. Can you go on ahead and give my thanks to everyone?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …C'mon, don't ask for the impossible. Someone's gotta answer those cheers, so you should hurry on over and…
choice_data_list: But you're the one everyone is waiting for.
But you're the one everyone is waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: INES! INES! INEEES! INEEES!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: INEEES! INEEES! INEEES! INEEES!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha… I'm not even in the winner's circle yet.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Are they going to keep chanting my name until I arrive?
choice_data_list: That's how inspiring your performance was.
That's how inspiring your performance was.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha… Geez…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Can we go slowly? I think I should be able to make it…
choice_data_list: Sure. Here, grab onto my shoulder.
Sure. Here, grab onto my shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks! Don't complain if I'm too heavy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I wasn't kidding when I told Trainer I couldn't walk. I mean, I used up every last ounce of energy I had in the race just now.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (This was my dream—charging across the Derby finish line with the crowd's passionate cheers behind me.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (And now, I've finally done it.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (But now… When I can hear everyone cheering my name so loud and clear…)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: INEEES! INEEES! INEEES! INEEES!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If everyone's cheering this loud for me, then I gotta give them what they want—one final spurt!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But the Triple Crown tour isn't over yet. You'll have to fend off another fierce opponent in the next race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Still, I'll be the one who takes the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The winning concert pulses with incredible energy, as spectators and Umamusume alike bask in the excitement until the very last light dims.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's as if they're reluctant to part with the crowning moment of the Derby dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As if they're celebrating the futures of all Umamusume who have crossed this significant milestone in their racing careers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I walk over to Ines Fujin, who sang splendidly as the lead star of the concert.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Say, Trainer. Do you think I managed to sing well up to the very end?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I hope I was able to express my gratitude to everyone for chanting my name the way they did.
choice_data_list: Definitely! It was a great concert!
Definitely! It was a great concert!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to… hear that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Really… glad…
Ines Fujin collapses onto the cold, hard floor of the backstage wings.
